rows.finding: A single Category-A metro member is paired with a same-named framework parent. The 2020 ADM2/ADM3 geometries are topologically equal for five pairs; the other two are not byte/geometrically identical, although their WGS84 source-edge land areas differ by under 0.0000005%. Investigate this repeated-territory representation; do not delete either ID based on this screen.
